response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanqc GROUP BY arcref), s AS (SELECT arcref, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share FROM c) SELECT arcref, cnt AS qc_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS deviation FROM s ORDER BY deviation DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Projects are those appearing in scanqc.arcref (projects with no QC records are excluded from the average share).
Ties at the 10th place are cut arbitrarily by LIMIT 10, as requested; no secondary sort key is applied.
